17511-foch-the-man-a-life-of-the-supreme.title: A Life of the Supreme Commander of the Allied Armies
17511-foch-the-man-a-life-of-the-supreme.creator: Clara E. Laughlin
17511-foch-the-man-a-life-of-the-supreme.description: A book by Clara E. Laughlin. Three Spirits stood on the mountain peak  And gazed on a world of red,--   Red with the blood of heroes,  The living and the dead;   A mighty force of Evil strove  With freemen, mass on mass. Three Spirits stood on the mountain peak  And cried: "They shall not pass!"

28293-the-tale-of-jolly-robin.title: (Trademark Registered)
28293-the-tale-of-jolly-robin.creator: Arthur Scott Bailey
28293-the-tale-of-jolly-robin.description: A book by Arthur Scott Bailey. Of course, there was a time, once, when Jolly Robin was just a nestling himself. With two brothers and one sister--all of them, like him, much spotted with black--he lived in a house in one of Farmer Green's apple trees.

35015-wrinkles-in-electric-lighting.title: Electric Lighting.
35015-wrinkles-in-electric-lighting.creator: Unknown
35015-wrinkles-in-electric-lighting.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Production of electric current in chemical battery--Current very   weak--Current compared to circulation of the blood--Strength and   volume of current--Pressure not sufficient without volume--Action   of current is instantaneous--Resistance to the passage of the   current--Copper the usual metal for conductors--Heat produced by   current when wire is too small 1

46060-of-the-injustice-of-counterfeiting.title: Of The Injustice Of Counterfeiting Books From Essays And Tre
46060-of-the-injustice-of-counterfeiting.creator: Immanuel Kant
46060-of-the-injustice-of-counterfeiting.description: A book by Immanuel Kant. If someone can dispose of something at pleasure in his own name, then that someone has a right to that thing. But if someone can perform only in the name of another, he transacts this business such that the other is thereby bound, as if the business were transacted by himself. (Quod quis facit per alium, ipse fecisse putandus set).

arxiv-1507-03685.title: TryLogic tutorial: An approach to learning Logic by proving and refuting
arxiv-1507-03685.creator: Patrick Terrematte, João Marcos
arxiv-1507-03685.description: A 2015 arXiv research paper by Patrick Terrematte, João Marcos. Aiming to offer a framework for blended learning to the teaching of proof theory, the present paper describes an interactive tutorial, called TryLogic , teaching how to solve logical conjectures either by proofs or refutations. The paper also describes the integration of our infrastructure with the Virtual Learning Environment Moodle through the IMS Learning Tools Interoperability specification, and evaluates the tool we have developed.

arxiv-2101-12446.title: Counterfactual State Explanations for Reinforcement Learning Agents via Generative Deep Learning Journal: Journal of Artificial Intelligence
arxiv-2101-12446.creator: Matthew L. Olson, Roli Khanna, Lawrence Neal, Fuxin Li, Weng-Keen Wong
arxiv-2101-12446.description: Abstract Counterfactual explanations, which deal with “why not?” scenarios, can provide insightful explanations to an AI agent’s behavior (( Miller 2019 ] . In this work, we focus on generating counterfactual explanations for deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents which operate in visual input environments like Atari.

arxiv-2110-10033.title: Towards an accurate model of small-scale redshift-space distortions in modified gravity 2021 Towards an accurate model of small-scale redshift-space distortions in modified gravity – 11
arxiv-2110-10033.creator: Cheng-Zong Ruan, Carolina Cuesta-Lazaro, Alexander Eggemeier, César Hernández-Aguayo, Carlton M. Baugh, Baojiu Li, Francisco Prada
arxiv-2110-10033.description: Abstract The coming generation of galaxy surveys will provide measurements of galaxy clustering with unprecedented accuracy and data size, which will allow us to test cosmological models at much higher precision than achievable previously. This means that we must have more accurate theoretical predictions to compare with future observational data.

arxiv-2211-11890.title: TEMPERA: Test-Time Prompt Editing via Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2211-11890.creator: Tianjun Zhang, Xuezhi Wang, Denny Zhou, Dale Schuurmans, Joseph E. Gonzalez
arxiv-2211-11890.description: Abstract Careful prompt design is critical to the use of large language models in zero-shot or few-shot learning. As a consequence, there is a growing interest in automated methods to design optimal prompts. In this work, we propose TE st-ti M e P rompt E diting using R einforcement le A rning (TEMPERA).

arxiv-2312-06409.title: PointVoxel: A Simple and Effective Pipeline for Multi-View Multi-Modal 3D Human Pose Estimation
arxiv-2312-06409.creator: Zhiyu Pan, Zhicheng Zhong, Wenxuan Guo, Yifan Chen, Jianjiang Feng, Jie Zhou, Department of Automation, BNRist, Tsinghua University, China
arxiv-2312-06409.description: Abstract Recently, several methods have been proposed to estimate 3D human pose from multi-view images and achieved impressive performance on public datasets collected in relatively easy scenarios. However, there are limited approaches for extracting 3D human skeletons from multimodal inputs (e.g., RGB and pointcloud) that can enhance the accuracy of predicting 3D poses in challenging situations.

arxiv-2405-13141.title: Offline robot programming assisted by task demonstration: an AutomationML interoperable solution for glass adhesive application and welding
arxiv-2405-13141.creator: M. Babcinschi a , F. Cruz a , N. Duarte a , S. Santos a , S. Alves a and P. Neto a
arxiv-2405-13141.description: Abstract Robots have been successfully deployed in both traditional and novel manufacturing processes. However, they are still difficult to program by non-experts, which limits their accessibility to a wider range of potential users. Programming robots requires expertise in both robotics and the specific manufacturing process in which they are applied.

arxiv-2406-04847.title: Do Language Models Exhibit Human-like Structural Priming Effects?
arxiv-2406-04847.creator: Jaap Jumelet 1 Willem Zuidema 1 Arabella Sinclair 2 1 Institute for Logic, Language and Computation 2 School of Natural and Computing Sciences University of Amsterdam University of Aberdeen jumeletjaap@gmail.com w.h.zuidema@uva.nl arabella.sinclair@abdn.ac.uk
arxiv-2406-04847.description: Abstract We explore which linguistic factors—at the sentence and token level—play an important role in influencing language model predictions, and investigate whether these are reflective of results found in humans and human corpora ( Gries and Kootstra, 2017 ) . We make use of the structural priming paradigm, where recent exposure to a structure facilitates processing of the same structure.

arxiv-2408-16961.title: The Future of Open Human Feedback
arxiv-2408-16961.creator: Shachar Don-Yehiya, Ben Burtenshaw, Ramon Fernandez Astudillo, Cailean Osborne, Mimansa Jaiswal, Tzu-Sheng Kuo, Wenting Zhao, Idan Shenfeld, Andi Peng, Mikhail Yurochkin, Atoosa Kasirzadeh, Yangsibo Huang, TatsunoriHashimoto, Yacine Jernite, Daniel Vila-Suero, Omri Abend, Jennifer Ding, Sara Hooker,
arxiv-2408-16961.description: Abstract Human feedback on conversations with language language models (LLMs) is central to how these systems learn about the world, improve their capabilities, and are steered toward desirable and safe behaviors. However, this feedback is mostly collected by frontier AI labs and kept behind closed doors.

arxiv-2502-08796.title: A Systematic Review on the Evaluation of Large Language Models in Theory of Mind Tasks
arxiv-2502-08796.creator: Karahan Sarıtaş, Kıvanç Tezören, Yavuz Durmazkeser
arxiv-2502-08796.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Karahan Sarıtaş, Kıvanç Tezören, Yavuz Durmazkeser. In recent years, evaluating the Theory of Mind (ToM) capabilities of large language models (LLMs) has received significant attention within the research community. As the field rapidly evolves, navigating the diverse approaches and methodologies has become increasingly complex. This systematic review synthesizes current efforts to assess LLMs’ ability to perform ToM tasks—an essential aspect of human cognition involving the attribution of mental states to oneself and others.

arxiv-2507-03073.title: Cornering Natural SUSY at a Tera- 𝒁 Z Factory
arxiv-2507-03073.creator: Admir Greljo, Ben A. Stefanek, Alessandro Valenti
arxiv-2507-03073.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Admir Greljo, Ben A. Stefanek, Alessandro Valenti. The future circular e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} collider (FCC-ee) stands out as the next flagship project in particle physics, dedicated to uncovering the microscopic origin of the Higgs boson. In this context, we assess indirect probes of the Minimal Supersymmetric Standard Model (MSSM), a well-established benchmark hypothesis, exploring the complementarity between Higgs measurements and electroweak precision tests at the Z Z -pole.

arxiv-2510-23039.title: Sublinear Sketches for Approximate Nearest Neighbor and Kernel Density Estimation
arxiv-2510-23039.creator: Ved Danait, Srijan Das, Sujoy Bhore
arxiv-2510-23039.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ved Danait, Srijan Das, Sujoy Bhore. Approximate Nearest Neighbor ( ANN ) search and Approximate Kernel Density Estimation ( A-KDE ) are fundamental problems at the core of modern machine learning, with broad applications in data analysis, information systems, and large-scale decision making. In massive and dynamic data streams, a central challenge is to design compact sketches that preserve essential structural properties of the data while enabling efficient queries.

arxiv-2602-07570.title: How does longer temporal context enhance multimodal narrative video processing in the brain?
arxiv-2602-07570.creator: Prachi Jindal, Anant Khandelwal, Manish Gupta, Bapi S. Raju, Subba Reddy Oota, Tanmoy Chakraborty
arxiv-2602-07570.description: Abstract Understanding how humans and artificial intelligence systems process complex narrative videos is a fundamental challenge at the intersection of neuroscience and machine learning. This study investigates how the temporal context length of video clips (3–12 s clips) and the narrative-task prompting shape brain-model alignment during naturalistic movie watching.

(540 vols.) collected by Wilson in India are now in the Bodleian library.

pmc-10628016.title: A scoring system based on fusion genes to predict treatment outcomes of the non-acute promyelocytic leukemia pediatric acute myeloid leukemia
pmc-10628016.creator: Wenwen Weng, Yanfei Chen, Yuwen Wang, Peiting Ying, Xiaoping Guo, Jinfei Ruan, Hua Song, Weiqun Xu, Jingying Zhang, Xiaojun Xu, Yongmin Tang
pmc-10628016.description: BackgroundFusion genes are considered to be one of the major drivers behind cancer initiation and progression. Meanwhile, non-acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) pediatric patients with acute myeloid leukemia (AML) in children had limited treatment efficacy. Hence, we developed and validated a simple clinical scoring system for predicting outcomes in non-APL pediatric patients with AML.

pmc-11470058.title: Endocannabinoid concentrations in major depression: effects of childhood maltreatment and relation to hippocampal volume
pmc-11470058.creator: Raegan Mazurka, Kate L Harkness, Stefanie Hassel, Niclas Stensson, Nikita Nogovitsyn, Jordan Poppenk, Jane A Foster, Scott D Squires, Jessie Rowe, Roumen V Milev, Katherine E Wynne-Edwards, Gustavo Turecki, Stephen C Strother, Stephen R Arnott, Raymond W Lam, Susan Rotzinger, Sidney H Kennedy, Benic
pmc-11470058.description: Evidence from preclinical animal models suggests that the stress-buffering function of the endocannabinoid (eCB) system may help protect against stress-related reductions in hippocampal volume, as is documented in major depressive disorder (MDD). However, stress exposure may also lead to dysregulation of this system.

pmc-11635738.title: ARMC5 selectively degrades SCAP-free SREBF1 and is essential for fatty acid desaturation in adipocytes
pmc-11635738.creator: Akifumi Uota, Yosuke Okuno, Atsunori Fukuhara, Shugo Sasaki, Sachiko Kobayashi, Iichiro Shimomura
pmc-11635738.description: SREBF1 plays the central role in lipid metabolism. It has been known that full-length SREBF1 that did not associate with SCAP (SCAP-free SREBF1) is actively degraded, but its molecular mechanism and its biological meaning remain unclear. ARMC5–CUL3 complex was recently identified as E3 ubiquitin ligase of full-length SREBF.

pmc-12471894.title: Evaluation of Endoscopic Findings in Gastrointestinal Tract Wall Thickening Detected on Abdominal Radiological Imaging: A Two-Center Retrospective Descriptive Study
pmc-12471894.creator: Mustafa Ergin, Fatih Kıvrakoğlu, Vishal G Shelat
pmc-12471894.description: Background and Objectives: The clinical significance of gastrointestinal (GI) tract wall thickening incidentally detected on abdominal imaging remains unclear. This study aimed to examine the relationship between GI tract wall thickening seen in imaging and what is found during endoscopy, as well as to explore how hemoglobin, C-reactive protein (CRP), and albumin levels can help predict the presence of malignancy.

pmc-12575251.title: Interventions for reducing caregiver burden in chronic dyspnea: a meta-analysis
pmc-12575251.creator: Fang Liu, Han Zhang, Shihan Li, Xianshan Wang, Xiaoqing Long, Yang Liu
pmc-12575251.description: BackgroundCaregivers of patients with chronic respiratory diseases, such as heart failure, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, and asthma, often experience significant physical, emotional, and psychological strain. This study aims to evaluate the effectiveness of various interventions designed to reduce caregiver burden and improve caregiver well-being.DesignMeta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs).

pmc-12613456.title: Exploring potential underestimates in fatal overdose mortality across major metropolitan areas in Mexico between 2005 and 2019
pmc-12613456.creator: Raul Bejarano-Romero, Jaime Arredondo Sánchez-Lira, Claudia Rafful, Eileen V. Pitpitan, Luis E. Esparza-Méndez, Michelle Poimboeuf, Chelsea L. Shover, David Goodman-Meza
pmc-12613456.description: BackgroundIn Mexico, low numbers of overdose deaths reported by government agencies, coupled with evidence of increased substance use in certain regions, suggest underreporting of overdose mortality. We explore the potential miscoding and underreporting of overdose deaths.MethodsWe assembled a mortality dataset using a combination of publicly available data and systematic freedom of information requests to Mexican state jurisdictions.

pmc-12668858.title: Isolation, Genomic Characterization, and Pathogenicity of a Novel Duck Orbivirus Genetically Similar to Corriparta Virus in China
pmc-12668858.creator: Liping Liu, Xiaozhen Guo, Feng Hu, Xiao Lu, Yumiao Lv, Jianhua Wang, Qin Ma, Yigang Tong, Fengjuan Tian, Yingjuan Qian, Yong-Sam Jung, Xiuli Ma, Bing Huang, Yufeng Li, Kexiang Yu
pmc-12668858.description: Corriparta virus (CORV), an arbovirus within the Orbivirus genus, exhibits a broad vertebrate host range but limited pathogenicity. In this study, we report the first isolation and characterization of a novel orbivirus genetically related to CORV, temporarily designed as novel duck orbivirus (NDORV), from Beijing ducks in Henan province, China, in 2024.

pmc-13240084.title: Normative cognitive data and psychometric validation of the 10/66 harmonized assessment protocol in Latin American
pmc-13240084.creator: Rodrigo S. Fernández, Jessica Presa, Issac Acosta, Ana Rodríguez Salgado, Ana Luisa Sosa, Daisy Acosta, Ivonne Z Jimenez‐Velazquez, Irene B Meier, Vaibhav A. Narayan, Mariella Guerra, Aquiles Salas, Juan J Llibre‐Rodriguez, Matthew Prina, Jorge J Llibre‐Guerra, for the 1066 Dementia Research Group
pmc-13240084.description: INTRODUCTIONThis study examined the latent cognitive structure of the 10/66 Dementia Research Group protocol and assessed its psychometric properties in culturally diverse older adults in Latin America and the Caribbean.METHODSData from 10,838 adults aged 65+ across five countries were analyzed. Confirmatory factor analyses tested unidimensional and multidimensional models representing major cognitive domains.

pmc-13253934.title: Podcast Episode 3: How Can Physicians Work Collaboratively to Improve Cardiovascular Outcomes in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes?
pmc-13253934.creator: Nihar R. Desai, Silvio E. Inzucchi, Eugene E. Wright
pmc-13253934.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Heart failure is a common and often underappreciated complication of type 2 diabetes. Patients with type 2 diabetes frequently have multiple interconnected comorbidities, including hypertension, chronic kidney disease, and obesity, which can culminate in cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic syndrome. Effective management of cardiovascular complications in patients with type 2 diabetes requires a comprehensive, coordinated approach to optimize treatment plans and improve overall patient care.

pmc-13256443.title: Anemia-Driven Phenotypes in Lung Cancer: Linking Inflammation and Sarcopenia
pmc-13256443.creator: Claudia Raluca Mariean, Oana Mirela Tiucă, Cristina Flavia Al-Akel, Sofia Teodora Muntean, Diana Maria Chiorean, Ovidiu Simion Cotoi
pmc-13256443.description: Background/Objectives: Lung cancer remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality and is characterized by complex tumor–host interactions, including systemic inflammation, metabolic dysregulation, and immune imbalance. This study aimed to evaluate whether a diagnosis of anemia reflects underlying inflammatory burden and to explore phenotype-based interactions between anemia, inflammation, and muscle depletion in lung cancer patients.

pmc-13437387.title: Workplace telepressure and workplace cognitive failure among hospital financial personnel: a mediation analysis and latent profile analysis based on work–family conflict and self-regulatory fatigue
pmc-13437387.creator: Qian Li, Xin He, Kexin Zhang, Shu Su, Keer Ren, Qianqian Liu

pmc-13686392.title: Assessment of the integrality of the psychosocial care network: multiple case study, Southern Region of Brazil, 2021
pmc-13686392.creator: Larissa Weber, Claudia Flemming Colussi, Larissa Weber, Claudia Flemming Colussi
pmc-13686392.description: Objective To assess the integrality of health actions of the services in the Psychosocial Care Network (Raps) in three municipalities in the Southern Region of Brazil, with different population sizes and varied Raps configurations. Method Evaluative research based on a multiple case study. An analysis and judgment matrix was used, comprising two dimensions, six subdimensions, and 16 indicators.
